title: Small fan-in-two circuit for every Boolean function
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$ and every Boolean function on assignments to $n$ variables, there is a directed acyclic circuit with those inputs and a valid output vertex that computes the function on every assignment. Each gate has at most two inputs, has no repeated input index, and every NOT gate has exactly one input; moreover, if the circuit size counts the input vertices and gates, then $(n+1)$ times its size is at most $40\cdot 2^n$.
hypotheses_covered: A nonnegative integer number of variables
A Boolean function on assignments to those variables
